name: waveguide_crossing
description: Silicon-nitride MMI waveguide crossing: two orthogonal 1x1 self-imaging MMI relays (W=8.5, L=186 um) crossing at the centre. Each 1 um strip tapers into the multimode section, whose length self-images the input at the far port; the perpendicular arm sees near-zero mode overlap. Tuned so the low-loss window is centred at 1550 nm: through -0.10 dB, crosstalk per orthogonal arm -85 dB, return -31 dB. Broadband eigenmode data over 1400-1700 nm (res 12).
notes: Supported natively by MMI_SParams (kind="crossing"): MMI_SMatrix(config, wavelength_um) returns the 4x4 S-matrix in port order [LEFT, THROUGH, TOP, BOTTOM], filled from the LEFT-driven row (through + the two orthogonal-arm crosstalks) and the input reflection by C4v symmetry. precomputed=True (default) interpolates precomputed.npz; precomputed=False runs it live via BuildCrossingGeometry/RunCrossingEigenmodeBand. precomputed.npz keys: wavelengths (N,), S (N,3)=[THROUGH,TOP,BOTTOM] forward transmission, S_refl (N,) input reflection. Standalone builder/plotters live in ai_workspace/WaveguideCrossing/ (crossing_common.py, tune_fast.py).
